data.fund_type: An open-ended equity scheme following multi-national companies (MNC) theme.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate long-term capital appreciation from a portfolio that is invested predominantly in equity and equity related securities of multi-national companies (MNC). However, there is no assurance that the objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related instruments of Multi-National Companies (MNCs) - 80% - 100% Equity and Equity Related instruments Other than Multi-National Companies (MNCs)- 0-20% Debt/Money Market Instruments - 0-20% Units of InvITs- 0-10%
data.exit_load: For redemption / switch out within 90 days from the date of allotment: 0.5% If units are redeemed or switched out on or after 90 days from the date of allotment -Nil Units issued on reinvestment of IDCWs shall not be subject to entry and exit load Any exit load charged (net off Goods and Services tax, if any) shall be credited back to the Scheme.
